jobs.description:
PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30.000 employees operating in over 40 countries. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company with the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.

One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and in our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2.700 employees, is in Düsseldorf and is the main location of around 500 employees.

The purpose of the Specialist Regional Risk Management is to manage, coordinate and drive all profit protection related topics in region, including data analysis and reporting. The goal is to create maximum transparency with regards to in-store transactions and processes and ensuring a high level of compliance. In addition, the reduction of regional shrinkage, the identification of priority stores and the performance of (virtual) store audits are highly important tasks to achieve.

A day in the life of a Specialist Retail Risk Management Region West (m/f/x):

- You will be responsible for reviewing and improving store processes to minimize loss and ensure compliance with company policies
- You will analyze in-store transactions, stock discrepancies, and cash differences to identify risks and drive corrective actions
- You will support the creation and update of internal policies, procedures, and operational guidelines related to loss prevention and profit protection
- You will collaborate with Central Risk Management, Local Operations and other departments to implement regional risk and profit protection plans
- You will provide practical support and solutions to all stores on high incident levels or elevated risk
- You will ensure all security systems (e.g., CCTV, alarms, EAS) are functional and store staff are trained in their proper use
- You will assist in investigations into suspected internal dishonesty or policy breaches, in coordination with HR and Legal
- You will deliver training to store teams on loss prevention practices, risk awareness, and emergency procedures
- You will conduct regular audits to monitor compliance with loss prevention policies and follow up on any findings

What do we need from you? You have:                                                                     

- University degree in business, economics, textile or related fields - or comparable education with relevant work experience
- Previous experience in profit protection, ideally gained within a retail environment
- Ability to research and analyze multiple data streams to make informed decisions
- Knowledge of store processes and procedures
- Strong project and time management skills with excellent attention to detail
- Knowledge of local/ regional store processes, laws & regulations and cultural needs
- Very good analytical skills, as well as advanced knowledge in Microsoft Excel and SAP BW
- Independent, highly structured and precise way of working
- Professional and authentic appearance & communication, discreet workstyle
- Willingness to travel if necessary      
- Fluent in both written and spoken English and German                                                                                                                                           

What you can expect from us:

- PVH offers you a smart working model (hybrid) including a flex office solution, a "work from anywhere" concept, meeting-free Fridays and many other components
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. The PVH Leadership Behaviors are the actions that unlock the potential of each of us. Whether you lead a team, a project or contribute your own expertise, everyone is a leader at PVH
- We promote a culture of development and offer training and learning opportunities through our own PVH University
- Multiple employee benefits such as employee discounts, mobility offers, internal sports classes and other initiatives

Our employees come together from all areas of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender you are welcome here.

jobs.description:
PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30,000 employees operating in over 40 countries. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company, driven by the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.

One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued and every voice is heard. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and across our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2,700 employees, is located in Düsseldorf and is the main workplace for around 500 employees.

As an Energy & Sustainability Specialist, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and sustainability performance of all Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger O&O stores within Hub West (EMEA).

You will manage administrative and commercial processes related to technical maintenance, servicing, and facility operations. This includes coordinating maintenance activities, handling damages and insurance claims, and working closely with internal stakeholders, landlords, and external service providers. A key focus of the role is driving energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives, and compliance with environmental and technical standards.

A day in the life of an Energy & Sustainability Specialist:

- Collect, monitor, and analyze energy consumption data across stores and office locations
- Develop and maintain the Energy Management System (EMS) in line with DIN / ISO standards (e.g. ISO 50001)
- Ensure compliance with German and EU energy regulations and support certification processes
- Track and evaluate energy-saving initiatives and sustainability measures
- Drive annual energy optimization and sustainability projects
- Lead and coordinate cross-functional Energy Task Force activities
- Prepare reports, KPIs, and presentations for General Management
- Support audits related to energy, sustainability, and utilities
- Implement sustainability and energy efficiency programs across retail and office locations
- Ensure compliance with environmental, health & safety, and fire protection regulations (e.g. BAFA, BGHW, TÜV)
- Coordinate maintenance, servicing, and facility operations across multiple locations
- Manage repair works, technical inspections, and preventive maintenance
- Monitor technical systems and identify improvement opportunities

What do we need from you? You have:

- A degree or vocational training in Facility Management, Engineering, Sustainability, Energy Management, or a related field
- 2–4 years of experience in facility management, technical services, sustainability, or energy management
- Experience in retail, real estate, or multi-site environments is a plus
- Strong organizational and coordination skills with a structured way of working
- A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities
- Strong communication skills and confidence working with various stakeholders
- Experience with energy management systems and audits
- Knowledge of EU/German energy and environmental regulations (e.g. ISO 50001)
- Familiarity with health & safety standards and compliance requirements
- Business fluent German and English (written and spoken)
- Willingness to travel and a valid driving license

What you can expect from us:

- A smart working model (hybrid), including flex office solutions, work-from-anywhere concept, and meeting-free Fridays
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. – our PVH Leadership Behaviors empower everyone to take ownership
- A strong culture of development with extensive training opportunities via PVH University
- A wide range of employee benefits, including employee discounts, mobility offers, and wellbeing initiatives

Our employees come from all walks of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender – you are welcome here.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: AMHS Software Automation Engineer (m/w/d) Optimize the
heartbeat of our production. As an AMHS Software Engineer, you are the
mastermind behind the control system of our Automated Material
Handling System (AMHS). You ensure that millions of transport
movements mesh seamlessly, eliminate bottlenecks, and take the
efficiency of our production line to the next level. Tasks Your
Mission: Maximizing Performance Through Intelligent Control: System
tuning & KPI boost: You analyze transfer data and optimize system
performance to achieve capacity targets and minimize process
variability. Seamless integration: You ensure seamless communication
between the AMHS, production equipment, and higher-level control
systems. Innovation & Automation: You design KPI monitoring systems
and develop solutions to reduce manual intervention (manual loading)
to a minimum. Project Management & Cross-FAB Leadership: You lead
cross-site projects to reduce costs and increase productivity—from
planning through to go-live. Team Mentoring: You will lead and develop
a team of technicians and engineers, foster team spirit, and share
your knowledge. Lifecycle Management: You will validate new software
features, lead annual upgrades and retrofit projects, and assist in
the setup of new fab installations. Profile You are a proactive
teamplayer who combines in-depth technical knowledge with leadership
skills and a hands-on approach. Education: Master’s degree in
Industrial Engineering, Computer Science (IT), Systems Engineering,
Automation Engineering, or a related field. Expertise: In-depth
knowledge of optimization algorithms, Industrial Engineering (IE), and
information technology (C#, Java, Python, SQL, Oracle, MS-SQL, VBA)
Experience: Professional experience in the semiconductor industry is
required Methodology: You are proficient in applying problem-solving
methods such as FMEA, SPC, and 8D. Personality: A goal-oriented team
player with leadership potential who keeps a cool head even in a
dynamic, fast-paced environment. Language: Fluent in English (company
language). Basic communication skills in Mandarin or German is a plus.
Training: Available for on-the-job training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months.
Location: Dresden, Germany. We offer Each journey starts with a first
step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be
working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at
the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources
of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the
world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC
Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities
related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.
Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with
real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity,
Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC). At ESMC we believe
in the power of inclusive leadership and passion. We demonstrate this
in our commitment to our people vision: create an inclusive
environment to inspire passion and enable the best in YOU. It is the
policy of ESMC to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all
persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and national origin,
citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion,
creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or
expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to
public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic
protected by federal, state or local law. Additional contact details
Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting team will
get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring criteria.

Responsibilities Build Our Employer Brand Develop and implement
creative employer branding initiatives across channels such as
LinkedIn, our career website and employer review platforms. Create
compelling content, including copy, campaign concepts and ideas for
visual and video content. Bring employer branding campaigns from the
initial concept through to execution. Ensure our global employer brand
is reflected authentically in our local activities. Shape Internal
Communications Help build and develop our internal communication
channels, including digital platforms and employee newsletters.
Discover and share stories from across the organization that
strengthen our culture and foster engagement. Translate complex topics
into clear, engaging communication for employees. Support internal
events, town halls and culture initiatives that connect our growing
workforce. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with colleagues
across HR and international stakeholders to ensure consistent and
effective communication. Act as a bridge between global corporate
communication principles and local implementation. Partner with HR and
Talent Acquisition to create a seamless employee and candidate
experience. Profile To be successful in this role, you should bring:
Professional experience in Employer Branding or Internal
Communications. Strong copywriting and storytelling skills with the
ability to create engaging content for different audiences. Excellent
communication skills in German and English (written and spoken). A
hands-on mindset with the motivation to turn ideas into action and
deliver results. The ability to work effectively with international
stakeholders in a multicultural environment. It would be a plus if you
also have: Experience building internal communication channels (e.g.
intranet, newsletters, employee communication platforms). Experience

creation. Experience in a growing, international or greenfield

Something New Join a true greenfield project where you’ll help shape
our employer brand and internal communications from the very
beginning. Enjoy Creative Ownership Bring your own ideas to life while
working within an international environment that values initiative,
collaboration and continuous improvement. Experience the Best of Both
Worlds Benefit from the agility and team spirit of a growing local
organization, backed by the strength and stability of global
technology leaders. Grow With Us As ESMC continues to expand, you’ll
have the opportunity to grow your role, broaden your expertise and
help shape the future of our organization Additional contact details
ESMC recruiting team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits
with hiring criteria. Thanks!

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in

committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels
and gauge readings. Ensures processing conditions and process output
are within regulatory limits and alerting management of discrepancies.
Perform standard and non-standard equipment maintenance, repairs and
modifications to ensure smooth operations inline with environmental
protection requirements. Profile Qualifications and Education:
Eligible to work in Germany and available for 3 months on-the-job
training in Taiwan. Technician or equivalent technical apprenticeship
education as electrician, in Mechatronics or a related field. Minimum
2–3 years of experience in a facilities, utilities, or electrical
related role. Qualified electrician to effectively detect and repair
defects in the operation of plant electrical equipment. Willingness to
work in a cleanroom environment with rotating shifts or on-call
duties. Deep interest in mechanical, chemical, and electrical
principles related to mechanical systems. Language Skills: Good
command of English with good command of German to communicate in our
international workplace. Professional Skills: Knowledge of industry
standards, codes and regulations, and the ability to apply to
maintenance operation of site Electrical systems. Functional level
knowledge of Electrical theory to troubleshoot and repair electrical
controls and electrical power distribution systems, complex procedures
pertinent to equipment and power distribution and wiring repair.
Operational knowledge of medium and high voltage cabling systems,
understanding the hazards associated with the specific class of system
voltage, and being able to mitigate these hazards through safe working
practices. Basic computer skills, ability to learn usage of standard
maintenance and process monitoring software. Able to read and
interpret technical manuals and process schematics. Capable of working
independently and cooperatively with other Technicians, Engineers, and
Managers with a strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy,
and problem-solving. Personal Attributes: Having strong values of
honesty, integrity and respect for others. We offer Each journey
starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will
provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future
of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential
to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international
startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the
experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced
semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample
opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation,
and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and
other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced
technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by

(ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive leadership and
passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our people vision:

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...
